name: Granules India Ltd.
about: Granules India Limited manufactures and sells active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), pharmaceutical formulation intermediates (PFIs), finished dosages (FDs), and peptides CDMO in India and internationally. It offers paracetamol, metformin, guaifenesin, ibuprofen, and methocarbamol, as well as prescription and over-the-counter products. The company also develops and manufactures tablets, capsules, press fits, oral solutions, suspensions, and powder for oral solutions. In addition, it provides development and manufacturing solutions for peptides, peptide fragments, and amino acid derivatives. The company offers its products in various therapeutic categories, including antiretroviral, anti-depressant, antihistamine, anti-diabetic, anti-cancer, multiple sclerosis, anti-thrombocytopenia, anti-ulcer, anti-convulsant, mucolytic/expectorant, anti-hypertensive, muscle relaxant, NSAIDs, anti-fi

buffett.name: Each ₹1 retained created ≥ ₹1 of market value

verdict.label: Looks expensive
reasons: Price implies ~23% a year profit growth for 10 years, versus ~6% that history and analysts support (reverse DCF at 10.8% cost of equity).
Trades at PE 32 vs a quality-and-growth-justified 48 for this sector; cheaper than peers of similar quality.
Since 2023, most of the 35% a year price gain came from re-rating (PE 15 → 32), not earnings growth (10% a year).
